title: Harbhajan Singh's security not withdrawn abruptly after he left AAP: P&H High Court
description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ruled that the Punjab government did not withdraw cricketer and Member of Parliament (MP) Harbhajan Singh's security abruptly after he left the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) to join the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).Justice Tribhuvan Dahiya noted that the decision to withdraw his security cover was taken following a due threat assessment by the Security Review Committee on March 3, which was much prior to his leaving the ruling party in Punjab."It cannot be said the
